question: In how many categories are loans provided under the MUDRA loan scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is **__4__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **4 categories** are provided under the MUDRA loan scheme.
 
• The categories are **Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun +**.
 
• **Shishu** category covers loans up to ₹50,000, **Kishore** category covers loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh, and **Tarun** category covers loans above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh. **Tarun Plus**: Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakhs
 
• The MUDRA loan scheme aims to support micro and small enterprises in India by providing them with necessary financial assistance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The MUDRA loan scheme was launched by the Government of India in **April 2015**.
 
• MUDRA stands for **Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency**.
 
• The scheme is part of the **Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)**.
 
• It aims to provide financial support to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
 
• The loans under the MUDRA scheme are collateral-free and can be availed from **commercial banks, RRBs, small finance banks, MFIs, and NBFCs**.
 
• The scheme has been instrumental in fostering entrepreneurship and generating employment in the country.
